notes: The repository file is a template: SRH_PARAMETER_FILE, ENORMAL_MODEL and SRH_MODEL are placeholders that a materialisation step replaces before Sentaurus can run it. The parser must report them as unknown Physics tokens, not as Workbench placeholders (they are not delimited by '@').
Parameter="SRH_PARAMETER_FILE" resolves to SRH_PARAMETER_FILE.par (no '.' in the base name); its existence is checked at gate 4, not by the parser.
Set("drain" mode current) and Goal{Current=} are supported constructs and must not appear in errors[]. CurrentPlot{AvalancheGeneration(Integrate(Semiconductor))} is ignored with W106.
